messages:
leo: Quick sync: want a tiny "preview" in saved-query edit that shows which route/model will be used right now and whether quota would block it. Keep minimal.

maya: yes. two labels: preferred (user hint) and predicted (runtime). predicted is the one we surface by default.

rob: backend: we can compute predicted with routing-sim but must avoid per-keystroke calls. plan: compute on save + on explicit "refresh preview" and cache for 2m.

isabel: telemetry: include preview_generation_id and preview_sample_id so dashboards can correlate. Also log preview_shown events.

leo: API sketch: POST /api/v2/saved_queries/:id/preview -> returns flat fields as strings: "predicted_model","predicted_cost_label","reasons_csv","cache_ttl_seconds". No heavy payload.

maya: UX: show small pill "predicted: redwood/gpt-4o-small" and a tiny "refresh" button. If reasons contain "quota" show yellow badge.

rob: corner case: route private or missing -> return "route_unavailable" in predicted_model and reasons="no_route". Console shows lock icon.

isabel: metrics: emit preview.divergence when first real request's served_model != predicted_model. We'll track per-preview_generation_id.

leo: RBAC: everyone with view_saved_queries can see preview; only editors can trigger refresh. Add audit entry when refresh triggered.

infra-bot: Feature flag "saved-query-mini-preview" created, default OFF in prod.

maya: next: rob to draft endpoint + cache policy, isabel to spec telemetry fields, I'll mock the pill. Ship behind flag.

leo: thanks — please add short acceptance criteria in the PR (cache TTL, audit entry on refresh, metric emitted).
